email.subject1: a signal play for your ecosystem
email.body1:
Chris, saw Salesmsg hit the Inc. 5000 and now runs 20-plus integrations across HubSpot, Pipedrive, and ActiveCampaign.

A partner ecosystem that wide usually means more co-sell targets than your team can personally cover, so partner-sourced pipeline plateaus right when the ecosystem is growing fastest. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage across partner accounts scales to 3-5x more meetings without new headcount.

I built a signal play for Salesmsg's partner ecosystem off hiring and tech-stack signals across your integration base. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Chris, quick follow-up on the ecosystem side for Salesmsg.

Most partnerships teams know which integrations drive revenue but can't put enough reps against co-sell motions to actually work the accounts. That coverage gap is where partner-sourced pipeline leaks, and it gets worse as you sign more integration partners.

I sketched a co-sell pilot playbook for running outbound into your top partner accounts without adding heads. Want to grab 15 minutes so I can walk you through it?
email.body3:
Chris, last bit of proof for Salesmsg.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I also pulled a pipeline gap analysis on how much co-sell coverage Salesmsg's ecosystem could add. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Chris, I will stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling partner-sourced pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. Ecosystem growth and co-sell coverage rarely move on the same timeline, and I know that stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through three personalized drafts to your top partner targets plus an AI-SDR co-sell play? I will tailor it to Salesmsg either way.
